contentHtml:
Copyable testing artifacts that apply Software Testing Standards.

Available Templates

File Purpose
Test Case Concise reusable definition of context, action, data and expected behavior

Template Rules

  • Preserve the distinction between test design and execution history.
  • Remove optional sections that do not affect execution or interpretation.
  • Replace every placeholder before marking a case active.
  • Store cases near the feature or in the repository's established test management location.
  • Do not include real credentials, production secrets or unnecessary personal data.

The template may be represented in Markdown or configured as equivalent fields in a test management tool. Tool-specific configuration must preserve the required information from Test Case Standards.
